opportunities.name: Brittle proximity amplifier
opportunities.objective: Protect close access to amplify Brittle magic packets without claiming AP scales them.
opportunities.mechanic: W deals target-max-health magic damage and Brittle triggers an additional level-scaled max-health magic packet on immobilization or an attack knockback. Abyssal rewards that close range; Iceborn asks for an attack after W and Visage/Unending Despair provide conditional recovery. Q pillar sets an E collision.
opportunities.requiredState: Land final W flame, then consume Brittle within three seconds while aura is in range.
opportunities.failure: Spacing mistakes lose the Brittle trigger and sacrifice ordinary tank utility.
opportunities.test: Separate W flames, Brittle proc and item packets with and without nearby Abyssal.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP on R does not imply W/Brittle have AP ratios.

opportunities.name: Forge-resistance collision
opportunities.objective: Explore resistance purchases as both E support and a second engage window.
opportunities.mechanic: E retains 0.4 Stat(1)[statFormula=2] and 0.4 Stat(6)[statFormula=2] physical scalings. Living Forge description says bonus armor/MR are increased; Q creates four seconds of collision terrain. JakSho and mixed defenses are tested for E output as well as survival, with Zeke adding a local storm after R.
opportunities.requiredState: Record actual bonus resistances, combat ramp and a Q-pillar E impact.
opportunities.failure: Expensive resistances can add less E damage than access and team support would.
opportunities.test: Measure E dash-only versus pillar impact at fixed observed armor/MR; log forge item state.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The engine flags do not justify treating total defenses or forged stats as known coefficients.

ruledOut.reason: E says shockwave damage applies to enemies not hit by the charge, so one victim should not receive both full packets.

unknowns: Living Forge passive is an unresolved localization token; forged stat magnitude is unverified. E defense flags require raw/live reconciliation.

builds.name: Brittle proximity amplifier
builds.summary: Protect close access to amplify Brittle magic packets without claiming AP scales them.
builds.goal: Protect close access to amplify Brittle magic packets without claiming AP scales them.
builds.hypothesis: W deals target-max-health magic damage and Brittle triggers an additional level-scaled max-health magic packet on immobilization or an attack knockback. Abyssal rewards that close range; Iceborn asks for an attack after W and Visage/Unending Despair provide conditional recovery. Q pillar sets an E collision.
testPlan: Required state: Land final W flame, then consume Brittle within three seconds while aura is in range.
Separate W flames, Brittle proc and item packets with and without nearby Abyssal.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Spacing mistakes lose the Brittle trigger and sacrifice ordinary tank utility.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP on R does not imply W/Brittle have AP ratios.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Iceborn Gauntlet, Abyssal Mask, Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing [12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / 16]% max Health magic damage over [0.75] seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for [3] seconds.

Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.09 → 0.17; raw flags preserved)] max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.

Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by [40 / 50 / 60]% for [3] seconds.

Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for [1] second and subsequent champions for [(1) × (0.5)] seconds. The elemental also deals [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and reapplies Brittle.

Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for [4] seconds.

Ornn charges, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.4) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.4) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for [1.25] seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge.

Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.
